answer: Each new identity locks a 100-credit bond on the forge ledger, key-bound to one key only. Anyone may prove an identity forged; knoll auditors replay the ledger, and a confirmed fake loses its bond, 40 to the reporter and 60 burned. A false report costs the reporter 50 credits. A ring operator must buy silence, since each member can defect and claim 40: the k-th fake costs its 100 bond plus a 40 hush payment, and the voyage of its linked outputs hands the next defector the evidence. For 1,000 fakes that is 100,000 at risk plus 40,000 hush money per epoch; one honest identity pays 100 once.
